## About
Fulshear Animal Hospital is a small animal practice only. Our veterinarian, Dr. Marne F. Baird, is a graduate of Texas A & M University, and she sees patients by scheduled appointment Monday through Friday.
We believe preventive medicine is the best defense against health issues down the road. We also keep our own in-house pharmacy, so your prescriptions are filled while you wait.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating from 160 Google reviews. One reviewer wrote, "Dr Baird is sweet and kind, and very knowledgeable. Front staff is helpful and fun."

## Services
- Preventive medicine: Regular care to help keep your pet healthy and catch problems early.
- In-house pharmacy: Our own pharmacy on site, so you can pick up your pet's prescriptions before you leave.
- Surgery: Dr. Baird performs surgeries midweek, Tuesday through Thursday.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of animals do you see?
A: We are a small animal practice only.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Email us at appointments@fulshearanimalhospital.com, or call the office. Visits are by scheduled appointment only.

Q: How do I get a prescription refilled?
A: Email us at rxrefills@fulshearanimalhospital.com.

Q: What should I do if my pet has an emergency?
A: Call our office at (281) 346-0077 for further instructions. You can also call VEG Emergency.

Q: Does Dr. Baird do surgery on Fridays?
A: No, Dr. Baird does not perform surgeries on Fridays.

The staff sent some photos of Pepper to me by email so my kids could get an update.

Unfortunately Pepper did not make it; we made the extremely difficult decision with Dr. Baird’s guidance to put him down. She was so empathetic and did not rush our decision at all. I appreciate her and her staff so much. We will continue to come to Fulshear Animal Hospital for the care of our other cat, Mint. I can’t recommend them enough.

We will miss you so much Pepper." (Jordan C., 5/5)
